about: Redesigned portfolio health: different cards and numbers from the rebuilds, so the same API disagrees with this design in more places.

fields.spend_you_manage: Total spend across the categories the user manages.
fields.spend.pct_of_total: The category's share of the user's total spend, 0 to 1.
fields.maturity_score: Category maturity on a 0 to 100 scale.
fields.risk_score: Composite risk score for the category.
fields.spend_trend.delta_pct: Change in spend between the last two spend uploads.
fields.waiting_on_decision.savings_count: Savings initiatives waiting on a decision. A count, never money.

endpoints.GET /api/category-health/portfolio: Portfolio landing page for users managing two or more categories. Rows are sorted by spend descending.
